before.questionText: Use the diagram above to answer this question. The structure that controls loss of water vapour during transpiration is labelled
before.explanation: The structure that controls water vapour loss is the stoma, whose opening and closing is controlled by its guard cells. In the diagram, the stomatal structure is labelled IV. When the stomatal pore closes, diffusion of water vapour out of the leaf is reduced.
